cues.headline: GOAL! Hugo Calloway!
cues.body: Westholm Albion score! It's Westholm Albion 1–0 Harbor City.

cues.headline: Rapid!
cues.body: Bram Rossiter just flew past at 27 km/h, the fastest of the match.

cues.headline: GOAL! Bram Rossiter!
cues.body: Harbor City score! It's Westholm Albion 1–1 Harbor City. It came 16 seconds after Harbor City won the ball high up the pitch.

cues.headline: Nobody's in charge now
cues.body: The game has settled. Ball over the last 5 minutes: Westholm Albion 50%, Harbor City 50%. Neither team on top.

cues.headline: Harbor City are on top
cues.body: Harbor City are on top: recovering the ball 5 times in the final third, winning the ball back in the opposition half 6 times and forcing Westholm Albion into 6 losses in their own half in the last 5 minutes.

cues.headline: Nobody's in charge now
cues.body: The game has settled. Ball over the last 5 minutes: Westholm Albion 58%, Harbor City 42%. Neither team on top.

cues.headline: GOAL! Niko Calloway!
cues.body: Westholm Albion score! It's Westholm Albion 2–1 Harbor City. A long ball over the press set it up.

cues.headline: End to end now!
cues.body: Nobody can keep the ball: it's changing hands 3.2 times a minute. Anything can happen.

recap.headline: Full time: Westholm Albion 2–1 Harbor City
recap.summary: A deserved win for Westholm Albion.
